missed_correctness_gold.title: The applyTemplateVariables method is called with request.filters as the third parameter, but this parameter is not used
missed_correctness_gold.description: The applyTemplateVariables method is called with request.filters as the third parameter, but this parameter is not used in the corresponding test setup.

promotion_candidates.title: Ad hoc filters are now applied twice (three times under shard splitting), duplicating label filters
promotion_candidates.description: applyTemplateVariables is not idempotent when request.filters is non-empty; it is called multiple times through the call chain (runSplitQuery → runSplitGroupedQueries → datasource.runQuery → DataSourceWithBackend.query), causing duplicate label filters in the final Loki query. With shardQuerySplitting enabled, this occurs three times. Fix: interpolate for split decisions without re-interpolating in downstream layers, either by keeping request.targets raw or by passing a skipTemplateVariables marker.
